settings.question: How does the Sleep Match work?
settings.answer: Your answers about how your pet sleeps, anything that affects their comfort, and their size are scored against our five sleep needs. The best fit wins — and we only recommend beds that are actually in that collection, in-stock ones first, with your size pre-selected where the bed comes in it.

settings.question: Do I have to give my email?
settings.answer: No. Your result appears straight away, on this page. We remember it on your device so product pages can show which beds match — nothing is sent to us.

settings.question: What if two needs sound right?
settings.answer: Your result shows the runner-up too. When in doubt, a pet's biggest comfort issue — stiff joints, nerves or heat — matters more than sleep style.
